normalized.result: Yes, that's exactly what I wanted. I clicked Save with the Rome address already in there and, instead of getting a second copy cluttering things up, it took me straight to the bookmark I already had, open and ready to edit, with a clear message telling me no duplicate was made. That's just right — it saves me from the mess of near-identical entries and I don't have to think about whether I've saved something before. Good. I'll be interested to see how it handles the slightly-different forms of the same link when you get to that.
